name: APIVerveHTMLEntitiesEncoderDecoder
summary: HTML Entities Encoder/Decoder converts special characters into safe HTML entities or restores encoded strings back to standard text.
description:
HTML Entities Encoder/Decoder converts special characters into safe HTML entities or restores encoded strings back to standard text. Pass any HTML markup or text snippet to receive the converted string, a replacement count, and a list of modified characters.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the HTML Entities Encoder/Decoder from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
